description: V3 PHASE-GATED INVARIANT REGISTRY (ADR-0023, ADR-0030). Registers all 30 invariants from docs/v3/verin-architecture-v3.md §17 with their phase gate and ACTIVATION state. HONESTY RULE: this file may only record whether an invariant is 'active' or 'not-yet-active' - it can NEVER store a pass/fail result. active-pass vs active-fail is COMPUTED by running each active invariant's mapped fitness mechanisms (scripts/v3-invariants.ts, blocking CI job 'v3-invariants'; registry integrity fenced by src/__tests__/fitness/v3-invariants.test.ts). A not-yet-active invariant renders visibly distinct from a passing one - never fake green (v3 §17 preamble). GATE MODEL (ADR-0030): every gate of the ratified 30-prompt sequence is registered (0, A, B, C, D, E, F, G/H, I) with its wave, prompt range, entry condition, outcome, and a list of TYPED requirements - 'invariant' | 'artifact' | 'fitness' | 'ci-gate' (machine-checkable) and 'evidence' (an outcome clause with no executable proof yet, which can never read green). Activation OWNERSHIP ('invariant.gate' - the one gate at which an invariant's activation is proven) is distinct from gate REQUIREMENT ('gates.<G>.requires'): a gate must require every invariant it owns, and may additionally reference invariants owned by EARLIER gates (Gate C restates invariant 1 without taking it from Gate A). ORDERING RULE: nothing a gate requires may land after that gate closes - every not-yet-active invariant's 'activationPrompts' must end at or before its own gate's last prompt, and every non-invariant requirement's 'prompt' at or before the requiring gate's last prompt. A gate with no machine-checkable requirement is rejected, because an empty set would read green merely by being registered. An invariant naming 'activationArtifacts' may not be flipped to 'active' until those artifacts exist on disk. All of this is one shared rule set (scripts/v3-gates.lib.ts) enforced BOTH by the fence (src/__tests__/fitness/v3-gate-ordering.test.ts) and by the blocking runner, so the two cannot drift. The 'documents' pins are verified by src/__tests__/fitness/arch-version.test.ts so build work cannot silently target a stale copy of the architecture; if a ratified document legitimately changes, update its sha256 here IN THE SAME PR and review every invariant below for drift.

0.title: Demo contract and walking skeleton

requires.ref: every demo-contract §4 required surface exists and is reachable in the walking skeleton
requires.note: NO MECHANISM YET, so this gate can never read green. The skeleton-honesty fence proves contract PARITY (scenario/firm/disposition) and the surface import boundary, and e2e/demo-journey.spec.ts walks and screenshots a hard-coded path - neither decides COMPLETENESS against the contract's §4 required-surface list, so a dropped surface would fail nothing. Supplying that mechanism is what flips gate 0 to decidable.

0.entryCondition: None - Wave 0 opens the build sequence.
0.outcome: The seven-minute journey is clickable on static/fake data, every required screen exists, and the UI does not invent decisions (Wave 0, prompts 1-3; ADR-0027 labeled fakes).

A.title: Foundation and boundaries
A.entryCondition: Wave 0 (prompts 1-3) has landed: the seven-minute journey is clickable on labeled fake data (ADR-0027).
A.outcome: Foundation invariants 1, 2, 4, and 5 are active and green (Wave A, prompts 4-7). Invariant 3 is NOT a Gate A requirement: its activation prerequisite is prompt 10, in Wave B, so requiring it here made Gate A unreachable by construction (ADR-0030).

B.title: Vocabulary and configuration
B.entryCondition: Wave B may not begin until prompts 5, 6, and 7 have landed AND Gate A's corrected requirements (invariants 1, 2, 4, 5) are active and green (ADR-0030).
B.outcome: Money movement and account opening are expressible as data and the golden corpus is stable; invariant 3 (no core module, directory, or evaluator branch named for a decision domain) is active and green once prompt 10 migrates the ADR-0010 account-opening flow definition into config/domains/ (Wave B, prompts 8-11; ADR-0030).

C.title: Intake, resolution, and evidence

requires.note: REFERENCED, NOT OWNED: v3's Gate C restates 'no PII in LLM artifacts', whose invariant subject is #1. Invariant 1's activation stays owned by Gate A (prompt 6) per the captain's ruled Gate A set; Gate C re-asserts it over the intake and evidence paths built in prompts 12-15.

requires.ref: the canonical request reaches a validated immutable DecisionInputBundle (the prompts 12-15 acceptance tests)
requires.note: NO MECHANISM YET: intake, entity binding, evidence snapshots, and bundle assembly do not exist, so nothing can decide this clause. It becomes an invariant/fitness requirement in the PR that lands prompt 15.

C.entryCondition: Gate B is green: money movement and account opening are expressible as data (Wave B, prompts 8-11).
C.outcome: The canonical request reaches a validated immutable input bundle with no PII in LLM artifacts (Wave C, prompts 12-15).

D.title: Deterministic judgment
D.entryCondition: Gate C is green: the canonical request reaches a validated immutable input bundle (Wave C, prompts 12-15).
D.outcome: Proceed, blocked, and prohibited decisions replay byte-identically; decision-core invariants 6-13 green (Wave D, prompts 16-19).

E.title: Policy and institutional logic
E.outcome: A natural-language draft becomes simulated and approved structured policy; policy invariants 14-17 green (Wave E, prompts 20-22).

F.title: Execution integrity
F.outcome: Concurrent, repeated, failed, and delayed execution paths are safe and recorded; approval/execution invariants 18-25 green against fakes (Wave F, prompts 23-26).

G/H.title: Real Salesforce, full assembly, and investor demo hardening
G/H.entryCondition: Gate F is green. Prompt 27 is DEFERRED pending sandbox access (ADR-0024); Phase 1 is never declared complete on fakes.
G/H.outcome: The full journey uses real Salesforce invocation and honest returned status; demo invariants 26-30 green (Waves G-H, prompts 27-29; Phase 1 completion).

I.title: Adversarial audit

requires.note: Prompt 30's required final report: pass/fail for every active invariant, unresolved findings by severity, reproduction steps, transferability and demo-credibility risks, and a diligence-facing statement of what Phase 1 does and does not prove.

requires.ref: no unresolved critical finding; every accepted limitation is visible in the demo and the documentation
requires.note: NO MECHANISM YET: severity adjudication is the adversarial reviewer's judgment, so the report's existence is checkable here but its verdict is not. This gate is never green on registration alone.

I.entryCondition: Gate G/H is green: the full journey runs on a real Salesforce invocation with honest returned status.
I.outcome: No unresolved critical finding; all accepted limitations are visible in the demo and documentation (Wave I, prompt 30).

invariants.name: No PII-bearing type is reachable from llm/
invariants.notes: ACTIVATED by prompt 6 (fm/verin-secbound-d8): the llm/ boundary (masked request schema + evidence-to-LLM projection), the Tokenized<T> scrubber-only factory (infrastructure/pii/tokenize.ts), the PIIBearing marker derivation, and the import-reachability + factory-construction fences. Runtime half: scrub-by-construction + the parseMaskedLlmRequest ingress gate (unit/llm-boundary.test.ts).

invariants.name: Every persisted record and repository operation is tenant-scoped
invariants.notes: org_id is the store-layer spelling of v3's FirmId (ADR-0026): every table carries org_id, every SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE must filter on it (AST-derived from the DDL). Prompt-5 decision contracts and prompt-7 ledger events use structured tenant-scoped references, and prompt-7 storage adds composite same-org foreign keys for decisions, bundles, evidence, and causation. Their registered boundaries reject cross-tenant configuration, source, policy, instruction, evidence snapshot, intent, input bundle, derived decision, approval template, role, subject, scope, execution target, reservation, verification rule, and ambiguity-candidate values. An exact runtime inventory covers every exported Zod value whose schema graph contains a scoped-reference collection, regardless of export name, alias, or wrapper reuse, and executes a legal and mixed-tenant parse probe for every registered boundary. EXTENDED by prompt 6: sealed TenantContext (contracts/tenant.ts) required on every repository/port signature (tenant-context-required fence) - missing tenant context cannot compile (unique-symbol brand) or parse (runtime seal assert).

invariants.name: No core module, directory, or evaluator branch is named for a decision domain
invariants.activatesWhen: the ADR-0010 account-opening flow definition migrates into the domain-configuration system (Wave B prompt 10, marriage-map C10) so no decision domain survives as a core module, directory, or evaluator branch; the naming fence ships in that PR
invariants.notes: GATED AT B, NOT A (ADR-0030). The decision-core subsystems scaffolded in Wave A (ADR-0026 / marriage-map C6) are substrate, not activation: this invariant's implementation prerequisite is prompt 10, which lands in Wave B, so requiring it at Gate A made Gate A unreachable by construction. Until prompt 10 exists, no document, proof, or UI may claim this invariant is implemented; the activationArtifacts above are the mechanical form of that rule.

invariants.name: Import boundaries match v3 §16
invariants.activatesWhen: the §16 module subsystems exist inside the four layers - the Wave A subjects (prompts 5-7) activate it at Gate A, and each v3 dependency rule (decision/ never imports llm/, no module imports config/, ...) lands as a ts-morph fence in the wave that creates its subject (ADR-0026), extending the same fence family without re-gating this invariant
invariants.notes: The four-layer dependency rule is already fenced, and prompt-7 ledger contracts, pure projection fold, infrastructure repository, and app transport honor it. The invariant remains not-yet-active until the remaining §16 subsystems and their pairwise import rules exist.

invariants.name: Ledger records are append-only
invariants.notes: Both audit-class stores stay mapped. The operational audit_log keeps its append-only DDL (migrations.ts) and audited-write helper fence. The sibling decision_ledger is synchronously appended with immutable evidence, input bundles, and decision records. All source tables reject UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE; a ts-morph anti-fork fence permits raw inserts only in the repository and migration. L1-L4 verification covers stored bytes, schema/serializer dispatch, promoted columns, and the per-org anchor. The CI gate verifies both decision and operational audit chains non-vacuously.

invariants.name: Policy evaluation is a pure function of an immutable DecisionInputBundle and a deterministic engine version
invariants.activatesWhen: the input bundle (Wave C prompt 15) and the deterministic evaluator (Wave D prompt 16) land

invariants.name: A proceed decision cannot exist without authority and an execution plan
invariants.notes: Structural since prompt 5 (ADR-0029): ProceedDecision is a strict schema REQUIRING authority + executionPlan (src/contracts/decision-core/decision.ts); the fence proves the missing/empty variants are parse errors. Prompt 17 adds property tests over the evaluator.

invariants.name: A blocked decision cannot carry authority or an execution plan
invariants.notes: Structural since prompt 5 (ADR-0029): BlockedDecision is a strict schema with no authority/plan keys - a smuggled key is a parse error. Prompt 17 adds property tests over the evaluator.

invariants.name: A prohibited decision cannot carry a resolving condition, authority, or execution plan
invariants.notes: Structural since prompt 5 (ADR-0029): ProhibitedDecision/Prohibition are strict schemas with no authority, plan, or resolving-evidence channel, and a prohibited DecisionRecord admits no revaluation conditions. Prompt 17 adds property tests over the evaluator.

invariants.name: Precedence is order-independent and every conflict emits a trace
invariants.activatesWhen: the precedence engine lands (Wave D prompt 17) with shuffled-seed order-independence property tests

invariants.name: A decision with blocking evidence gaps cannot proceed automatically
invariants.activatesWhen: the validation stage lands (Wave C prompt 15; validate is distinct from evaluate - present-but-stale evidence cannot silently proceed)

invariants.name: Explanation is derived from the evaluation trace
invariants.activatesWhen: the evaluator + explanation trace land (Wave D prompt 16); WhyBubble becomes the renderer of ExplanationNodes (ADR-0028, marriage-map §2)

invariants.name: Replay from the pinned bundle is byte-identical under canonical serialization
invariants.activatesWhen: replay lands (Wave D prompt 19) with adversarial break attempts (live-source changes, reordering, TZ changes, engine upgrades)

invariants.name: No policy reaches approved without a recorded simulation run
invariants.activatesWhen: the policy lifecycle lands (Wave E prompt 20: draft -> simulated -> in_review -> approved -> active -> superseded)

invariants.name: No active policy is mutable
invariants.activatesWhen: the policy lifecycle lands (Wave E prompt 20; changes fork a new version, supersession preserves old replay)

invariants.name: Firm policy configuration contains no arbitrary executable code
invariants.notes: Activated by prompt 9 (ADR-0053). Policy is a CLOSED, typed AST: strict Zod schemas admit exactly the ratified ValueNode/PredicateNode/PolicyEffect variants (grammar 1.0.0; 1.1.0 adds only the reserved 'elapsed' op, refused by the loader as grammar-only). loadPolicy performs the seven ratified checks against Map-backed pinned registries - unknown operators, paths, context keys, primitives, parameters, strategies, and templates are load errors; prototype-chain paths are simply unknown; constants are inert data, never interpreted; effect conflicts are rejected by the conservative disjointness prover, never resolved by rule order. The policy-ast fence pins the grammar closure, domain neutrality, purity (no clock/random/tz/locale), the migration fixture digests, and named-deferral reachability. The interpreter itself (src/domain/policy/evaluate.ts) is a pure four-phase function; determinism, totality, monotonicity, and fail-closed behavior are property-tested (fast-check families A-H in src/__tests__/unit/policy-properties.test.ts; family H holds temporal-typed fact reads to canonical bytes, D-186).

invariants.name: LLM output cannot directly activate or bind policy
invariants.activatesWhen: the NL policy path lands (Wave E prompt 22: LLM output must survive AST validation, simulation, and attributed human approval before activation)

invariants.name: Every non-automatic approval stage defines role eligibility, quorum, actor-distinctness, expiration, and escalation
invariants.activatesWhen: authority/approval stages land (Wave D prompt 18) on the FlowStep suspend/resume substrate (ADR-0011)

invariants.name: Approval invalidates on material input-bundle hash change
invariants.activatesWhen: approval binding to decisionHash + inputBundleHash lands (Wave D prompt 18; ApprovalInvalidated ledger event)

invariants.name: Every external execution step has an idempotency key and verification rule
invariants.activatesWhen: the execution planner and adapter conformance suite land (Wave F prompts 24-25), proving the required keys and rules are honored at execution
invariants.notes: Schema substrate today: ExecutionStep and CompensatingAction both require stable idempotency, conflict keys, reservation references, preconditions, and a verification-rule reference; the fence rejects incomplete compensation and aliased parent/compensation keys. Every house-CRM write also carries an idempotency key with a replay-tested exactly-once effect (charter #16). The invariant remains not-yet-active until the planner and adapter conformance suite prove those contracts are honored by external execution.

invariants.name: Pre-execution revalidation occurs after approval and before external execution
invariants.activatesWhen: revalidation lands (Wave F prompt 23: refresh material evidence, rebuild bundle, invalidate stale approvals)

invariants.name: Conflicting pending or in-flight actions are considered through conflict keys and reservations
invariants.activatesWhen: conflict keys + append-only reservations land (Wave F prompt 23; reference failure: two simultaneous $75k requests individually valid, jointly overcommitted)

invariants.name: Every execution and status occurrence is recorded as a ledger event
invariants.activatesWhen: the typed LedgerEntry union (Wave A prompt 7) and execution events (Wave F prompt 25) land
invariants.notes: Prompt 7 lands the typed execution/status event vocabulary and append-only store. The invariant remains not-yet-active until Wave F execution and status producers prove every real occurrence reaches it.

invariants.name: A failure becomes a derived decision only when policy requires judgment; it never disappears into logs alone
invariants.activatesWhen: the event-driven exception loop lands (Wave F prompt 25: classify -> ExceptionDecisionRequested only when judgment is required)

invariants.name: Every real adapter and fake passes the same conformance suite
invariants.activatesWhen: the three-port conformance suite lands (Wave F prompt 24; the real Salesforce adapter is additionally gated by ADR-0024)

invariants.name: The identical $75,000 request produces different correct results for Firm A and Firm B with zero core-code change
invariants.activatesWhen: the full vertical is assembled (Wave G prompt 28: Firm B differs only through configuration)

invariants.name: The UI distinguishes blocked, prohibited, approved, submitted, and verified states
invariants.activatesWhen: the demo UI lands (Wave 0 prompt 3 begins it - docs/demo-design-language.md now authored per ADR-0028; demo-complete at Wave H prompt 29)

invariants.name: Every external status claim shown in the demo is backed by a real adapter response
invariants.activatesWhen: the real Salesforce adapter lands (Wave G prompt 27) - DEFERRED pending sandbox access (ADR-0024, captain directive 2026-07-26). Until the trigger fires, no external status claim may be presented as real (fake-backed claims stay provenance-labeled per ADR-0027), and Phase 1 is never declared complete

invariants.name: The constrained natural-language policy path results in a structured draft, simulation, approval, version activation, and changed replay outcome
invariants.activatesWhen: the NL policy path lands (Wave E prompt 22) and is demo-choreographed (Wave H prompt 29)

invariants.name: The printable decision record can be reconstructed entirely from ledger and replay artifacts
invariants.activatesWhen: the printable examiner-grade artifact is generated from ledger + replay data (Wave G prompt 28)
